## Market.getAvgBorrowRate() method

Returns the average rate at which interest \_would\_ accrue for borrowers of this market, if `accrueInterest` was called at the given timestamp (scaled by WAD).

**Signature:**

```typescript
getAvgBorrowRate(timestamp?: BigIntish): bigint;
```
